{{Top|leg}}
A '''shift coffer''', also known as a '''Bith hiding cube''', was a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] cube measuring approximately three-quarters of a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] on each side and served as a small safe with the unique ability to become invisible to the naked eye. Originally designed by [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] engineers, the coffer's walls were embedded with special [[fiber optic relay]]s that redirect light around the cube's surface. When seamlessly integrated into a wall, the shift coffer vanished, merging flawlessly with the surrounding wall. When placed in an open area, the coffer bent light around itself, rendering it almost invisible. [[Veretrex Securities]] had designed such a shift coffer, the [[Hiding Cube SCT-1000]]. Another known model was the [["Sleepsafe" shift coffer]] by [[SecuriCo]]rp.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
